chapter: Joining Goodman and views on arranging
title: Benny Goodman's frugality and background
summary: Hammond brought Sauter to Goodman; Sauter explains Benny's quirks as the residue of ghetto upbringing.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: We have to get back to Benny. We've been jumping around but never really nailing him squarely. How did this offer to come and work for Benny come about?

John Hammond. Red was scuffling and split with Mildred, he had gone off on his own and I guess Benny needed somebody at that point, so they offered and I made a decision and I went. I always felt like I was leaving home, it
He wasn't malicious as a rule; was he?

I don't think he was. I think this was all a result of growing up in the ghetto. I think that anyone who has to go through that sort of thing will have some residue. All his brothers have it too in different ways; they're not all the same.
That probably accounts for his legendary frugality.
